blocks.text: Zscaler Deception allows you to send event notifications as emails when a threat is detected. You can enable notifications and customize the notification subject and the event fields included in the email body to provide the information most relevant to your organization.
By default, the subject line for the email notification uses the following text:
You can modify this text using the built-in events.
You cannot change the template of the email body. However, you can include more event fields in the email body.
To learn more, see Customizing Event Notification Templates.
